title: Exact-contract observed monetisation clock
scope: Compute and publish +20%/+30% first-observed-profit n_q50/n_q80 with evidence, failures, censoring and missing-data counts.
strategy_owner: Claude: expiry selection and all entry/exit policies
required_checks: Exact OCC identity and same-contract ask-to-bid observations with shared costs
No data or archived receipts after the injected decision cutoff
Missing is not zero; zero bid is not a realised total loss
No half-target, ATR or modelled price proxy for observed profit
Non-overlapping origin windows and explicit count reconciliation
Quantiles explicitly conditional on observable hits; not an 80% success probability
No pooling across expiries or inferring a forecast from one contract's history
No changes to expiry, direction, rank, permission or Lane B
